explanation: Sai ở (B) 'was starting'. Hành động ngắn xen vào hành động đang diễn ra dùng quá khứ đơn: 'started'; 'were waiting' là hành động nền.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Did (A) you saw (B) the (C) football match last night (D)?
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'saw'. Sau 'Did', động từ trở về nguyên mẫu: 'Did you see...?'

question:
Find the incorrect part:
The concert were (A) very (B) good, and the (C) tickets were cheap (D).
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'were'. Chủ ngữ 'The concert' số ít → 'was'. ('the tickets' số nhiều nên 'were' ở vế sau là đúng.)

question:
Find the incorrect part:
She bought (A) a new dress and (B) weared (C) it to (D) the party.
explanation: Sai ở (C) 'weared'. 'wear' là động từ bất quy tắc, quá khứ là 'wore'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
They studyed (A) English (B) for (C) two hours yesterday (D).
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'studyed'. Động từ tận cùng bằng phụ âm + y: đổi 'y' thành 'i' rồi thêm -ed → 'studied'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
I didn't went (A) to (B) school yesterday (C) because I was (D) sick.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'didn't went'. Sau 'didn't', động từ ở dạng nguyên mẫu: 'didn't go'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Where do (A) you buy (B) that beautiful (C) bag last week (D)?
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'do'. Có 'last week' → quá khứ đơn, câu hỏi dùng 'did'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
The weather were (A) very (B) bad, so we stayed (C) at home (D).
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'were'. 'The weather' là danh từ số ít → 'was'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
The guide didn't tell (A) us that the museum closed (B) early, so we didn't visited (C) the final room (D).
explanation: Sai ở (C) 'didn't visited'. Sau 'didn't' phải dùng động từ nguyên thể: didn't visit.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
When the rain started (A), we hurryed (B) back to the café and waited (C) there for an hour (D).
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'hurryed'. Với động từ kết thúc bằng phụ âm + y, đổi 'y' thành 'i' rồi thêm '-ed': hurried.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
I think it will rains (A) tomorrow (B), so take (C) an (D) umbrella.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'will rains'. Sau 'will', động từ ở dạng nguyên mẫu: 'will rain'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
My sister are going to (A) study (B) in (C) Australia next year (D).
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'are going to'. Chủ ngữ 'My sister' số ít → 'is going to'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Will (A) you helping (B) me with (C) my homework tonight (D)?
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'helping'. Sau 'Will', động từ ở dạng nguyên mẫu: 'Will you help...?'

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Don't worry. I am (A) call you as soon as (B) I arrive (C) home (D).
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'am'. 'am call' sai cấu trúc. Lời hứa/quyết định tức thời dùng 'will + V': 'I will call you'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
After the exam, we are going to (A) spending (B) two days with (C) our cousins in Da Nang (D).
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'spending'. Sau 'be going to' phải dùng động từ nguyên thể: spend.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
My brother is more tall (A) than (B) me, but I am (C) heavier (D).
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'more tall'. 'tall' là tính từ ngắn → so sánh hơn thêm -er: 'taller'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Ho Chi Minh City is biger (A) than (B) Can Tho and (C) much (D) busier.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'biger'. 'big' kết thúc bằng 1 nguyên âm + 1 phụ âm → gấp đôi phụ âm: 'bigger'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
My second presentation was much (A) more good (B) than the first because I spoke more slowly (C) and looked at the audience (D).
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'more good'. Dạng so sánh hơn bất quy tắc của 'good' là 'better'; có thể nói 'much better'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
The instructions are not (A) enough clear (B) for new students to follow (C) without asking for help (D).
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'enough clear'. Khi bổ nghĩa cho tính từ, 'enough' đứng sau tính từ: clear enough.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
This is the goodest (A) restaurant (B) in (C) town (D).
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'the goodest'. 'good' có so sánh nhất bất quy tắc: 'the best'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
She is the beautifulest (A) girl (B) in (C) my class (D).
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'beautifulest'. 'beautiful' là tính từ dài → so sánh nhất: 'the most beautiful'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Of all the questions in the test, number twelve was the most difficult (A), but number six was the most easiest (B) for me (C) to answer (D).
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'the most easiest'. 'Easy' là tính từ ngắn, dạng so sánh nhất là 'the easiest', không dùng đồng thời 'most' và '-est'.

question: I enjoy ______ to music while I am doing housework.
explanation: 'enjoy + V-ing' → 'enjoy listening'; 'to listening' chỉ đúng khi 'to' là giới từ trong một cụm khác.

question: She decided ______ a new laptop after comparing several models.
explanation: 'decide + to V' → 'decided to buy'.

question: Do you want ______ to the cinema, or would you rather stay home?
explanation: 'want + to V' → 'want to go'; không nhầm với 'would rather + V' ở vế sau.

question: I'm good at ______ pictures.
explanation: Sau giới từ 'at' dùng V-ing → 'good at drawing'.

question: We hope ______ you again soon.
explanation: 'hope + to V' → 'hope to see'.

question: Thank you for ______ me with my homework.
explanation: Sau giới từ 'for' dùng V-ing → 'Thank you for helping'.

question: My father stopped ______ two years ago. Now he is much healthier.
explanation: 'stop + V-ing' = ngừng hẳn một thói quen → 'stopped smoking' (vì vậy bây giờ khoẻ hơn).

question: She is a very ______ driver. She never has accidents.
explanation: Trước danh từ 'driver' cần tính từ → 'careful'.

question: Please speak ______. The baby is sleeping.
explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'speak' cần trạng từ → 'quietly'.

question: The movie was very ______. I almost fell asleep.
explanation: Tính từ đuôi -ing miêu tả bản chất sự vật (bộ phim gây chán) → 'boring'. '-ed' miêu tả cảm xúc của người.

question: I was very ______ when I heard the good news.
explanation: Tính từ đuôi -ed miêu tả cảm xúc của người → 'I was excited'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
My (A) sister and me (B) go (C) to school together (D) every day.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'me'. Ở vị trí chủ ngữ (trước động từ 'go') phải dùng đại từ chủ ngữ: 'My sister and I'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Excuse me (A), is (B) this pen your (C) or Lan's (D)?
explanation: Sai ở (C) 'your'. Không có danh từ theo sau → dùng đại từ sở hữu 'yours' (= your pen).

question:
Find the incorrect part:
The cat is eating it's (A) food in (B) the (C) kitchen now (D).
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'it's'. 'it's' = it is. Trước danh từ 'food' cần tính từ sở hữu 'its'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Can you tell (A) they (B) about (C) the meeting tomorrow (D)?
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'they'. Sau động từ 'tell' cần đại từ tân ngữ 'them'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Lan says her (A) brother is bringing his (B) laptop, but he's (C) charger is still at home (D).
explanation: Sai ở (C) 'he's' (= he is/has). Trước danh từ 'charger' cần tính từ sở hữu 'his'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
If you see Mr Long, please give (A) he (B) this form and ask him to sign (C) it before Friday (D).
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'he'. Sau động từ 'give' cần đại từ tân ngữ 'him', không dùng đại từ chủ ngữ 'he'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
My birthday is on (A) March (B), and my sister's birthday is (C) on May 5th (D).
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'on'. Tháng (March) dùng 'in'; ngày cụ thể (May 5th) mới dùng 'on'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
We arrived (A) to (B) the airport at (C) 6 a.m. on (D) Monday.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'to'. 'arrive' đi với 'at' (nơi nhỏ, cụ thể như sân bay) hoặc 'in' (thành phố, quốc gia), không dùng 'arrive to'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
I was (A) born on (B) 2005 in (C) a (D) small village.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'on'. Năm (2005) dùng giới từ 'in': 'in 2005'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
He goes (A) to work with (B) bus every (C) day (D).
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'with'. Phương tiện đi lại dùng 'by': 'by bus'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
The office is open (A) from Monday to Friday, but it closes in (B) noon on (C) the last Friday of each month (D).
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'in'. Với thời điểm 'noon', ta dùng 'at': closes at noon.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
What (A) time do (B) the train leave (C) for (D) Hanoi?
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'do'. Chủ ngữ 'the train' số ít → câu hỏi hiện tại đơn dùng 'does'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Why do (A) you so (B) tired today (C)? Did (D) you sleep late?
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'do'. 'tired' là tính từ → câu hỏi dùng động từ 'be': 'Why are you so tired?'

question:
Find the incorrect part:
How many (A) brothers (B) does (C) you have (D)?
explanation: Sai ở (C) 'does'. Chủ ngữ 'you' → trợ động từ 'do': 'How many brothers do you have?'

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Which student (A) does (B) usually brings (C) the attendance list to class (D)?
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'does'. 'Which student' là chủ ngữ của câu hỏi, nên không dùng trợ động từ; câu đúng là 'Which student usually brings...?'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
How many (A) sugar do (B) you want (C) in (D) your coffee?
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'many'. 'sugar' là danh từ không đếm được → 'How much'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
I would like (A) any (B) water (C), please (D).
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'any'. Khi yêu cầu/đề nghị lịch sự ('I would like...'), dùng 'some'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
There are two childrens (A) playing (B) in (C) the park (D).
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'childrens'. 'children' đã là dạng số nhiều bất quy tắc của 'child', không thêm -s.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
We need (A) a (B) rice (C) and two (D) eggs.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'a'. 'rice' là danh từ không đếm được, không dùng 'a' → 'some rice'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
The receptionist gave us (A) some useful informations (B) about the buses that stop (C) near our hotel (D).
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'informations'. 'Information' là danh từ không đếm được và không thêm '-s'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
We didn't see (A) some (B) empty seats, so we stood (C) near the door for the whole journey (D).
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'some'. Trong câu phủ định mang nghĩa không có chiếc ghế trống nào, phải dùng 'any'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Look (A)! Those boys are swim (B) in (C) the (D) river.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'are swim'. Hiện tại tiếp diễn: be + V-ing → 'are swimming'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Please (A) don't make noise. My brother studying (B) for (C) his (D) exam.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'studying'. Hiện tại tiếp diễn cần động từ 'be': 'My brother is studying'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
What are (A) you do (B) at (C) the moment? I (D) need your help.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'do'. 'are you ... at the moment' là hiện tại tiếp diễn → 'What are you doing?'

question:
Find the incorrect part:
She is (A) writeing (B) an email to (C) her teacher right now (D).
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'writeing'. Động từ tận cùng bằng -e câm: bỏ 'e' rồi thêm -ing → 'writing'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Why is (A) your classmates waiting (B) outside while the teacher is preparing (C) the room (D)?
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'is'. Chủ ngữ 'your classmates' là số nhiều, nên câu hỏi hiện tại tiếp diễn phải dùng 'are'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
She can speaks (A) three (B) languages very (C) well (D).
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'can speaks'. Sau 'can', động từ ở dạng nguyên mẫu, không thêm -s: 'can speak'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Could (A) you to open (B) the window, please (C)? It's hot (D) in here.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'to open'. Sau 'Could', động từ ở dạng nguyên mẫu không 'to': 'Could you open...?'

question:
Find the incorrect part:
My sister, together with her two friends, are (A) responsible (B) for (C) the book club this term (D).
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'are'. Chủ ngữ chính là 'My sister' (số ít); cụm 'together with...' không làm chủ ngữ thành số nhiều → 'is'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
There are (A) a notebook and two pens (B) on (C) the teacher’s desk near the window (D).
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'are'. Trong cấu trúc 'There be', động từ thường hòa hợp với danh từ gần nhất; 'a notebook' số ít → 'There is'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
I am (A) from Can Tho, and my friends is (B) from (C) Vinh Long. We are (D) classmates.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'is'. Chủ ngữ 'my friends' số nhiều → 'are'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Is (A) your brothers good (B) at (C) English or (D) math?
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'Is'. Chủ ngữ 'your brothers' số nhiều → câu hỏi bắt đầu bằng 'Are'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Neither my brother nor my sister watch (A) TV (B) before (C) they finish (D) their homework.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'watch'. Với 'neither...nor', động từ hòa hợp với chủ ngữ gần nhất 'my sister' (số ít) → 'watches'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Does (A) your mother likes (B) spicy (C) food or (D) sweet food?
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'likes'. Trong câu hỏi có 'Does', động từ chính ở dạng nguyên mẫu: 'like'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Lan don't (A) drink (B) coffee because (C) it makes (D) her nervous.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'don't'. Chủ ngữ 'Lan' số ít → phủ định dùng 'doesn't'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
We usually (A) goes (B) to the market on (C) Sunday (D) mornings.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'goes'. Chủ ngữ 'We' → động từ giữ nguyên mẫu 'go'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
The list of items we need are (A) on (B) the kitchen table, but the keys (C) are beside (D) the door.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'are'. Chủ ngữ chính là 'The list' (số ít), không phải 'items' → 'is'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
My father doesn't (A) works (B) on (C) Saturdays, so he often (D) plays tennis.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'works'. Sau 'doesn't', động từ ở dạng nguyên mẫu: 'doesn't work'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
She never is (A) late for (B) class because she always (C) gets up (D) early.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'never is'. Trạng từ tần suất đứng SAU động từ 'be': 'is never'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
How often (A) are (B) you go (C) swimming in (D) the summer?
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'are'. Câu hỏi với động từ thường 'go' ở hiện tại đơn dùng trợ động từ 'do': 'How often do you go...?'

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Tom plays often (A) badminton (B) with (C) his friends after (D) school.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'plays often'. Trạng từ tần suất đứng TRƯỚC động từ thường: 'often plays'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Her mother works (A) as (B) an (C) university librarian in (D) Can Tho.
explanation: Sai ở (C) 'an'. 'University' bắt đầu bằng âm /j/ như 'you', là phụ âm → 'a university librarian'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
In the morning, a (A) sun rises (B) in (C) the (D) east.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'a'. Vật duy nhất (mặt trời) dùng mạo từ 'the': 'the sun'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
We waited (A) for a (B) hour (C) before the doctor called (D) our name.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'a'. Chữ 'h' trong 'hour' không được phát âm nên từ bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm /aʊ/ → 'an hour'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
When I was (A) a child, I live (B) in (C) a small village near (D) the river.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'live'. 'When I was a child' chỉ quá khứ → quá khứ đơn 'lived'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Right now, my father cooks (A) dinner (B) and my mother is reading (C) a book (D).
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'cooks'. 'Right now' → hành động đang diễn ra, dùng hiện tại tiếp diễn 'is cooking'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Yesterday I called (A) Lan, but she doesn't answer (B) her (C) phone (D).
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'doesn't answer'. 'Yesterday' → quá khứ đơn: 'didn't answer'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Every morning, he gets up (A) at six and had (B) breakfast (C) with (D) his family.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'had'. 'Every morning' chỉ thói quen và 'gets up' ở hiện tại → 'has'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Last night, Nam is watching (A) a movie with (B) his friends at (C) the cinema (D).
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'is watching'. 'Last night' chỉ quá khứ → quá khứ đơn 'watched'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Next weekend, my family visited (A) our (B) relatives in (C) Long An (D).
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'visited'. 'Next weekend' chỉ tương lai → 'is going to visit'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
My mother usually (A) drank (B) tea, but yesterday (C) she drank coffee (D).
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'drank'. 'usually' chỉ thói quen hiện tại → 'drinks'. Vế sau có 'yesterday' mới dùng quá khứ 'drank'.

question: I wanted to buy the jacket, ______ I left it because it was too expensive.
explanation: Hai ý trái ngược: muốn mua nhưng cuối cùng không mua → 'but'. 'Although' cần mở đầu một mệnh đề phụ.

optionNotes.so: 'so' = vì vậy (đứng trước kết quả); 'so + tính từ/trạng từ' = rất, quá (không có danh từ theo sau).

question: It was raining heavily, ______ the match continued as planned.
explanation: Mưa lớn nhưng trận đấu vẫn tiếp tục → quan hệ tương phản, dùng 'but'.

optionNotes.so: 'so' = vì vậy (đứng trước kết quả); 'so + tính từ/trạng từ' = rất, quá (không có danh từ theo sau).

question: Lan went to bed early ______ she had worked late the night before.
explanation: Mệnh đề sau nêu nguyên nhân Lan đi ngủ sớm → 'because'.

optionNotes.so: 'so' = vì vậy (đứng trước kết quả); 'so + tính từ/trạng từ' = rất, quá (không có danh từ theo sau).

question: You can take the early bus ______ wait for the cheaper one at noon.
explanation: Hai khả năng loại trừ nhau → dùng 'or'.

optionNotes.so: 'so' = vì vậy (đứng trước kết quả); 'so + tính từ/trạng từ' = rất, quá (không có danh từ theo sau).

question: My brother likes football, ______ he doesn't like basketball.
explanation: Hai ý trái ngược (thích – không thích) → 'but'.

optionNotes.so: 'so' = vì vậy (đứng trước kết quả); 'so + tính từ/trạng từ' = rất, quá (không có danh từ theo sau).

question: She can speak English ______ French. She learned both at school.
explanation: 'She learned both' → cả hai ngôn ngữ → 'and'.

optionNotes.so: 'so' = vì vậy (đứng trước kết quả); 'so + tính từ/trạng từ' = rất, quá (không có danh từ theo sau).

question: We didn't go to the beach ______ the weather was bad.
explanation: Vế sau là lý do không đi biển → 'because'.

optionNotes.so: 'so' = vì vậy (đứng trước kết quả); 'so + tính từ/trạng từ' = rất, quá (không có danh từ theo sau).

question: My brother is a good ______. He plays the guitar in a band.
explanation: Sau 'a good' cần danh từ chỉ người → 'musician' (nhạc sĩ, người chơi nhạc).

question:
Find the incorrect part:
You should to (A) see (B) a doctor if (C) your cough gets (D) worse.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'should to'. Sau động từ khuyết thiếu 'should' là V nguyên mẫu không 'to' → 'should see'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Students mustn't (A) wear (B) uniforms on Fridays; they (C) can wear whatever (D) they like.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'mustn't'. Vế sau 'they can wear whatever they like' → không bắt buộc (không phải bị cấm): 'don't have to'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
The more (A) you practice, the more good (B) your English will (C) become (D).
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'more good'. So sánh hơn của 'good' là 'better': 'The more..., the better...'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Despite (A) it was raining (B) heavily, the football (C) match continued (D).
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'Despite'. 'Despite' + danh từ/V-ing; trước một mệnh đề (it was raining) phải dùng 'Although'.

question: ______ she was very tired, she finished all her homework.
explanation: Sau chỗ trống là mệnh đề 'she was very tired' và hai vế tương phản → 'Although'. 'Despite/Because of' cần cụm danh từ; 'in spite' phải có 'of'.

question: The flight was delayed ______ the bad weather.
explanation: Theo sau là cụm danh từ 'the bad weather' → 'because of'. 'Because/although' cần mệnh đề; dạng đúng là 'despite', không có 'of'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
I am interested in learn (A) Japanese because I want (B) to work (C) in Japan one day (D).
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'learn'. Sau giới từ 'in' động từ ở dạng V-ing → 'interested in learning'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
My parents want (A) me study (B) medicine, but I prefer (C) drawing (D) and design.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'study'. 'want' + tân ngữ + to V → 'want me to study'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
She finished (A) to write (B) her essay at (C) midnight and went (D) to bed.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'to write'. 'finish' + V-ing → 'finished writing'.

question: Have you ever thought about ______ abroad?
explanation: Sau giới từ 'about' động từ ở dạng V-ing → 'thought about studying'.

question: It's ______ to cross this road. The traffic is very heavy.
explanation: Sau 'It's' cần tính từ → 'dangerous' (nguy hiểm).

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Minh speaks (A) English very fluent (B) because (C) he lived in Australia (D) for five years.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'fluent'. Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'speaks' cần trạng từ → 'fluently'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
The decide (A) to close the factory (B) was (C) very difficult (D) for the manager.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'decide'. Sau mạo từ 'The' cần danh từ → 'decision' (quyết định).

question: We were ______ by the beautiful view from the top of the mountain.
explanation: Diễn tả cảm xúc của người ('We were...') → tính từ đuôi -ed: 'amazed' (kinh ngạc, thích thú).

question:
Find the incorrect part:
I lived (A) in Can Tho since (B) I was ten (C) and still know (D) the city well.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'lived'. 'Since I was ten' và ý vẫn còn đúng ở hiện tại → hiện tại hoàn thành 'have lived', không dùng quá khứ đơn.

question: I haven't seen my cousins ______ last Lunar New Year.
explanation: 'Since' + mốc bắt đầu ('last Lunar New Year') đi với hiện tại hoàn thành. 'For' cần khoảng thời gian; 'during' chỉ khoảng sự kiện.

optionNotes.for: 'for' + khoảng thời gian (for two hours) hoặc nghĩa 'dành cho'.
optionNotes.from: 'from' = từ (nơi chốn, thời điểm bắt đầu).

question:
Find the incorrect part:
She has (A) yet (B) finished (C) her report, so she can (D) go home early today.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'yet'. Câu khẳng định dùng 'already' (đã... rồi) đứng giữa 'has' và V3. 'yet' dùng trong câu phủ định/câu hỏi và đứng cuối câu.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
We have gone (A) to Phu Quoc last (B) summer and stayed (C) there for (D) a week.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'have gone'. 'last summer' là thời điểm xác định trong quá khứ → quá khứ đơn 'went'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
By the time I got (A) to the station, the train already left (B) and (C) the next one was not due (D) for an hour.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'already left'. Việc tàu rời đi hoàn tất trước mốc quá khứ 'got' → quá khứ hoàn thành 'had already left'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
This pagoda, which stands (A) beside the river, has built (B) more than (C) 200 years ago and is still visited (D) daily.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'has built'. Ngôi chùa nhận hành động xây và có mốc quá khứ '200 years ago' → bị động quá khứ 'was built'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
The exam results will announce (A) on (B) the school website next (C) Monday, so please (D) check it then.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'will announce'. Kết quả thi 'được công bố' (bị động) trong tương lai → 'will be announced'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Smoking is not allow (A) anywhere (B) in (C) the hospital, including (D) the parking lot.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'is not allow'. Bị động: be + V3 → 'is not allowed'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Unless the weather doesn't improve (A) by noon, we will (B) cancel (C) the picnic and stay (D) home.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'doesn't improve'. 'Unless' đã mang nghĩa 'if...not', nên mệnh đề sau dùng dạng khẳng định 'improves', không thêm phủ định lần nữa.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
If I have (A) more money, I would (B) buy a (C) new laptop for (D) my studies.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'have'. Mệnh đề chính có 'would' → câu điều kiện loại 2: If + quá khứ đơn → 'had'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
If you had (A) tell (B) me about (C) the problem, I would have helped (D) you.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'tell'. Câu điều kiện loại 3: If + had + V3 → 'had told'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
I have a friend who (A) father (B) is a pilot, and she has traveled (C) to many (D) countries.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'who'. Chỉ sự sở hữu (bố của người bạn), có danh từ 'father' theo sau → 'whose'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
This is the café which (A) we first (B) met each other three years ago (C) and still visit (D) regularly.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'which'. Sau chỗ trống là mệnh đề đầy đủ 'we first met each other', nên cần trạng từ quan hệ chỉ nơi chốn 'where' (= at which).

question:
Find the incorrect part:
Last week, Lan told (A) me that she is (B) too (C) busy to go (D) out that evening.
explanation: Sai ở (B) 'is'. Câu tường thuật với 'told' (quá khứ) về một sự việc đã qua ('that evening') → lùi thì: 'was'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
He asked (A) me where (B) did I live (C) and what I did (D) for a living.
explanation: Sai ở (C) 'did I live'. Câu hỏi tường thuật dùng trật tự trần thuật (chủ ngữ + động từ), không có trợ động từ 'did' → 'where I lived'.

question:
Find the incorrect part:
When I was a child, I use to (A) walk (B) to school with (C) my older (D) brother.
explanation: Sai ở (A) 'use to'. Thói quen trong quá khứ ở câu khẳng định → 'used to + V'.

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
watch / TV / they / seldom / on weekdays
options: They seldom watch TV on weekdays.
They seldom TV watch on weekdays.
Watch they seldom TV on weekdays.
They watch seldom TV on weekdays.
explanation: Trạng từ tần suất đứng sau chủ ngữ và trước động từ thường: S + adv + V + O. → 'They seldom watch TV on weekdays.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
I / unexpectedly met / at the market yesterday / my former teacher
options: I unexpectedly met at the market yesterday my former teacher.
Unexpectedly met I my former teacher at the market yesterday.
I my former teacher unexpectedly met at the market yesterday.
I unexpectedly met my former teacher at the market yesterday.
explanation: Trật tự câu cơ bản: Chủ ngữ + Động từ + Tân ngữ + Thời gian/Cách thức. → 'I unexpectedly met my former teacher at the market yesterday.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
she / for the interview / carefully chose / a less expensive dress
options: She carefully chose a less expensive dress for the interview.
Carefully chose she a less expensive dress for the interview.
She a less expensive dress carefully chose for the interview.
She carefully chose for the interview a less expensive dress.
explanation: Trật tự câu cơ bản: Chủ ngữ + Động từ + Tân ngữ + Thời gian/Cách thức. → 'She carefully chose a less expensive dress for the interview.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
the students / cleaned / after the lesson / the classroom
options: The students cleaned the classroom after the lesson.
The students the classroom cleaned after the lesson.
Cleaned the students the classroom after the lesson.
The students cleaned after the lesson the classroom.
explanation: Trật tự câu cơ bản: Chủ ngữ + Động từ + Tân ngữ + Thời gian/Cách thức. → 'The students cleaned the classroom after the lesson.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
they / will visit / next month / Hue
options: They will visit Hue next month.
They will visit next month Hue.
Will visit they Hue next month.
They Hue will visit next month.
explanation: Trật tự câu cơ bản: Chủ ngữ + Động từ + Tân ngữ + Thời gian/Cách thức. → 'They will visit Hue next month.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
you / what / buy at the market / did
options: What you did buy at the market?
What did you buy at the market?
Did what you buy at the market?
What did buy at the market you?
explanation: Câu hỏi có từ để hỏi: Wh- + trợ động từ/be + chủ ngữ + động từ...? → 'What did you buy at the market?'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
where / your family / go last summer / did
options: Did where your family go last summer?
Where did go last summer your family?
Where your family did go last summer?
Where did your family go last summer?
explanation: Câu hỏi có từ để hỏi: Wh- + trợ động từ/be + chủ ngữ + động từ...? → 'Where did your family go last summer?'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
the concert / will / when / start
explanation: Câu hỏi có từ để hỏi: Wh- + trợ động từ/be + chủ ngữ + động từ...? → 'When will the concert start?'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
my brother / is / taller / our father / than
options: My brother is taller than our father.
My brother is than taller our father.
My brother is taller our father than.
My brother taller is than our father.
explanation: So sánh hơn: S + be/V + adj-er/more adj + than + O. → 'My brother is taller than our father.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
than / this phone / that one / more expensive / is
options: This phone more expensive is than that one.
This phone is more expensive that one than.
This phone is than more expensive that one.
This phone is more expensive than that one.
explanation: So sánh hơn: S + be/V + adj-er/more adj + than + O. → 'This phone is more expensive than that one.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
is / the Red River / the Mekong River / longer / than
options: The Mekong River is than longer the Red River.
The Mekong River is longer than the Red River.
The Mekong River is longer the Red River than.
The Mekong River longer is than the Red River.
explanation: So sánh hơn: S + be/V + adj-er/more adj + than + O. → 'The Mekong River is longer than the Red River.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
is / than / more interesting / my new job / my old one
options: My new job is than more interesting my old one.
My new job more interesting is than my old one.
My new job is more interesting my old one than.
My new job is more interesting than my old one.
explanation: So sánh hơn: S + be/V + adj-er/more adj + than + O. → 'My new job is more interesting than my old one.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
runs / her brother / she / than / faster
options: She faster runs than her brother.
She runs faster than her brother.
She runs than faster her brother.
She runs faster her brother than.
explanation: So sánh hơn: S + be/V + adj-er/more adj + than + O. → 'She runs faster than her brother.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
every day / drink / you / should / more water
options: You drink should more water every day.
You should more water drink every day.
Drink you should more water every day.
You should drink more water every day.
explanation: Động từ khuyết thiếu: S + modal + V nguyên mẫu + O. → 'You should drink more water every day.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
uniforms / must / at school / wear / students
options: Students must wear uniforms at school.
Students must uniforms wear at school.
Students wear must uniforms at school.
Wear students must uniforms at school.
explanation: Động từ khuyết thiếu: S + modal + V nguyên mẫu + O. → 'Students must wear uniforms at school.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
finish / the project / by Friday / have to / we
options: We finish have to the project by Friday.
Finish we have to the project by Friday.
We have to the project finish by Friday.
We have to finish the project by Friday.
explanation: Động từ khuyết thiếu: S + modal + V nguyên mẫu + O. → 'We have to finish the project by Friday.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
you / mustn't / your motorbike / park / here
options: Park you mustn't your motorbike here.
You park mustn't your motorbike here.
You mustn't your motorbike park here.
You mustn't park your motorbike here.
explanation: Động từ khuyết thiếu: S + modal + V nguyên mẫu + O. → 'You mustn't park your motorbike here.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
go / yesterday / we / didn't / to school
options: We didn't to school go yesterday.
Go we didn't to school yesterday.
We go didn't to school yesterday.
We didn't go to school yesterday.
explanation: Câu phủ định: S + trợ động từ + not + V nguyên mẫu + O. → 'We didn't go to school yesterday.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
visit / my aunt / am going to / next week / I
options: I am going to visit my aunt next week.
I visit am going to my aunt next week.
I am going to my aunt visit next week.
Visit I am going to my aunt next week.
explanation: Tương lai gần: S + am/is/are going to + V nguyên mẫu + O + thời gian. → 'I am going to visit my aunt next week.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
they / are going to / next year / a new car / buy
options: They are going to buy a new car next year.
Buy they are going to a new car next year.
They are going to a new car buy next year.
They buy are going to a new car next year.
explanation: Tương lai gần: S + am/is/are going to + V nguyên mẫu + O + thời gian. → 'They are going to buy a new car next year.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
has / hair / black / long / Hoa
explanation: Trật tự tính từ: kích thước/độ dài (long) đứng trước màu sắc (black): 'long black hair'. → 'Hoa has long black hair.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
drives / my uncle / big / red car / a
options: My uncle drives a big red car.
My uncle drives red car big a.
My uncle drives a red car big.
My uncle drives big a red car.
explanation: Mạo từ 'a' đứng đầu; kích thước (big) đứng trước màu sắc (red): 'a big red car'. → 'My uncle drives a big red car.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
beautiful / white dress / is wearing / a / she
options: She is wearing a white dress beautiful.
She is wearing beautiful a white dress.
She is wearing white dress beautiful a.
She is wearing a beautiful white dress.
explanation: Mạo từ 'a' đứng đầu; tính từ chỉ quan điểm (beautiful) đứng trước màu sắc (white): 'a beautiful white dress'. → 'She is wearing a beautiful white dress.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
in winter / than / Hanoi / Can Tho / colder / is
options: Hanoi is colder than Can Tho in winter.
Hanoi colder is than Can Tho in winter.
Hanoi is than colder Can Tho in winter.
Hanoi is colder Can Tho than in winter.
explanation: So sánh hơn: S + be/V + adj-er/more adj + than + O. → 'Hanoi is colder than Can Tho in winter.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
in Can Tho / was / a lot of rain / there / last night
options: There a lot of rain was in Can Tho last night.
A lot of rain there was in Can Tho last night.
There was last night in Can Tho a lot of rain.
There was a lot of rain in Can Tho last night.
explanation: Cấu trúc: There + was + danh từ + nơi chốn + thời gian. → 'There was a lot of rain in Can Tho last night.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
swim / when I was ten / very well / could / I
options: I swim could very well when I was ten.
Swim I could very well when I was ten.
I could swim very well when I was ten.
I could swim when I was ten very well.
explanation: Động từ khuyết thiếu: S + modal + V nguyên mẫu + O. → 'I could swim very well when I was ten.'

question:
Put the lines in the correct order to make a conversation:
a. A: Can I leave a message?
b. B: Sure. Go ahead.
c. B: Sorry, he's in a meeting right now.
d. A: Hello, may I speak to Mr. Binh, please?
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: d - c - a - b. Hội thoại luân phiên A – B; mỗi câu trả lời phải đáp đúng câu ngay trước nó (Telephone).

question:
Put the lines in the correct order to make a conversation:
a. B: I went to Phu Quoc with my family.
b. A: What did you do last weekend?
c. A: Really? How was it?
d. B: It was great. The beaches were beautiful.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: b - a - c - d. Hội thoại luân phiên A – B; mỗi câu trả lời phải đáp đúng câu ngay trước nó (Past events).

question:
Put the lines in the correct order to make a conversation:
a. A: You should take a break and drink some water.
b. A: You look tired. What's wrong?
c. B: I have a bad headache.
d. B: Good idea. Thanks.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: b - c - a - d. Hội thoại luân phiên A – B; mỗi câu trả lời phải đáp đúng câu ngay trước nó (Advice).

question:
Put the lines in the correct order to make a conversation:
a. B: Something in marketing, I hope.
b. B: I'm going to look for a job in Ho Chi Minh City.
c. A: What kind of job?
d. A: What are you going to do after graduation?
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: d - b - c - a. Hội thoại luân phiên A – B; mỗi câu trả lời phải đáp đúng câu ngay trước nó (Future plans).

question:
Put the lines in the correct order to make a conversation:
a. B: Thank you. Your room is 305, on the third floor.
b. A: Excuse me, I'd like to check in. I have a reservation.
c. B: Sure. What's your name, please?
d. A: Tran Thi Hoa.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: b - c - d - a. Hội thoại luân phiên A – B; mỗi câu trả lời phải đáp đúng câu ngay trước nó (Hotel).

question:
Put the lines in the correct order to make a conversation:
a. A: Is everything OK? You look worried.
b. B: Yes, but it isn't there.
c. A: Did you check your bag?
d. B: I lost my student card.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: a - d - c - b. Hội thoại luân phiên A – B; mỗi câu trả lời phải đáp đúng câu ngay trước nó (Problems).

question:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a paragraph:
a. In the evening, we drove home, tired but happy.
b. Last Sunday, my family went to the beach.
c. When we arrived, we swam and played games on the sand.
d. We left home early in the morning.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: b - d - c - a. Kể theo trình tự thời gian: sáng sớm rời nhà → khi đến nơi → buổi tối về nhà.

question:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a paragraph:
a. Finally, wait for five minutes, then stir and enjoy.
b. To make a cup of Vietnamese milk coffee, you need coffee, hot water and condensed milk.
c. First, put some condensed milk in a glass.
d. Next, put the coffee filter on the glass and add hot water.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: b - c - d - a. Câu nêu nguyên liệu đứng đầu, sau đó theo các từ nối 'First → Next → Finally'.

question:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a paragraph:
a. I have a best friend named Ngoc.
b. Now, seven years later, we study at the same university in Can Tho.
c. We met on our first day at secondary school.
d. We still meet for coffee every weekend.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: a - c - b - d. Giới thiệu bạn → gặp nhau lần đầu → 'Now, seven years later' (bảy năm sau lần gặp đó) → 'still' (vẫn tiếp tục).

question:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a paragraph:
a. Best wishes, Hung
b. Thank you for your English lessons this semester.
c. Dear Ms. Lan,
d. I learned a lot, especially in speaking.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: c - b - d - a. Email: lời chào 'Dear...' → nội dung → lời kết và tên người viết.

question:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a paragraph:
a. Finally, when I got to class, I found out that my homework was at home.
b. First, I woke up late and missed the bus.
c. Then, it started to rain, and I didn't have an umbrella.
d. Yesterday was a terrible day for me.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: d - b - c - a. Câu chủ đề đứng đầu, sau đó theo các từ nối 'First → Then → Finally'.

question:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a paragraph:
a. I hope she will teach us again next year.
b. Her lessons are always fun because she uses games and songs.
c. Ms. Hoa is my English teacher.
d. Because of this, all the students in my class love her lessons.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: c - b - d - a. Giới thiệu cô Hoa → bài học vui → 'Because of this' (kết quả) → mong muốn ở cuối.

question:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a paragraph:
a. Then, use the word in a sentence of your own.
b. First, write each new word in a small notebook.
c. Finally, review the notebook every evening before bed.
d. Here are some tips for learning new English words.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: d - b - a - c. Câu chủ đề ('Here are some tips') → 'First → Then → Finally'.

question:
Choose the best way to combine the sentences:
I like coffee. My sister likes coffee, too.
options: I like coffee, but my sister doesn't.
Neither my sister nor I like coffee.
My sister and I both likes coffee.
My sister and I both like coffee.
explanation: Hai người cùng thích → 'both'. Chủ ngữ 'My sister and I' số nhiều → 'like' (không thêm -s).

question:
Choose the sentence with the same meaning:
Lan is taller than Mai.
options: Mai is as tall as Lan.
explanation: Lan cao hơn Mai ⇔ Mai thấp hơn Lan.

question:
Choose the sentence with the same meaning:
The film started at 8 p.m. and finished at 10 p.m.
options: The film started two hours late.
explanation: Từ 8 giờ đến 10 giờ tối → bộ phim kéo dài 2 tiếng.

question:
Choose the sentence with the same meaning:
Nobody in my class is taller than Huy.
options: Huy is not as tall as anyone in my class.
Only one student in my class is taller than Huy.
Huy is the tallest student in my class.
Huy is taller than every student outside my class.
explanation: Không ai cao hơn Huy → Huy cao nhất lớp: 'the tallest'.

question:
Choose the sentence with the same meaning:
It's not a good idea to stay up late.
explanation: 'not a good idea' = không nên → 'shouldn't'.

question:
Choose the sentence with the same meaning:
How about going to the park?
options: Why do we go to the park?
explanation: 'How about + V-ing?' là lời gợi ý ⇔ 'Let's + V nguyên mẫu'.

question:
Choose the sentence with the same meaning:
Students are not allowed to use phones in the exam.
options: Students don't have to use phones in the exam.
Students should use phones in the exam.
Students mustn't use phones in the exam.
Students can use phones in the exam.
explanation: 'not allowed' = bị cấm → 'mustn't'. 'don't have to' chỉ có nghĩa là không bắt buộc.

question:
Choose the sentence with the same meaning:
I started learning English when I was 10. I am 20 now.
options: I am learning English 10 years ago.
I learned English for 10 years ago.
I have learned English for 10 years.
I have learned English since 10 years.
explanation: Hành động bắt đầu trong quá khứ và còn tiếp tục → hiện tại hoàn thành + 'for' + khoảng thời gian: 'for 10 years'.

question:
Choose the correct question for this answer:
I bought it last Saturday.
explanation: Hỏi thời gian trong quá khứ → 'When did you + V nguyên mẫu?'

question: You are writing an email to your teacher. Choose the best closing.
explanation: Email trang trọng (gửi giáo viên) nên kết thúc bằng 'Best regards,' hoặc 'Kind regards,'.

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
coffee without sugar / almost always / drinks / before work / my father
options: My father drinks almost always coffee without sugar before work.
Drinks my father almost always coffee without sugar before work.
My father almost always drinks coffee without sugar before work.
My father almost always coffee without sugar drinks before work.
explanation: Trạng từ tần suất đứng sau chủ ngữ và trước động từ thường: S + adv + V + O. → 'My father almost always drinks coffee without sugar before work.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
eats / during the week / she / hardly ever / fast food
options: She eats hardly ever fast food during the week.
Eats she hardly ever fast food during the week.
She hardly ever eats fast food during the week.
She hardly ever fast food eats during the week.
explanation: Trạng từ tần suất đứng sau chủ ngữ và trước động từ thường: S + adv + V + O. → 'She hardly ever eats fast food during the week.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
play / after school / we / badminton / usually
options: We usually badminton play after school.
Play we usually badminton after school.
We play usually badminton after school.
We usually play badminton after school.
explanation: Trạng từ tần suất đứng sau chủ ngữ và trước động từ thường: S + adv + V + O. → 'We usually play badminton after school.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
with her friends / often / walks / Lan / to school
options: Lan often walks to school with her friends.
Lan often to school walks with her friends.
Lan walks often to school with her friends.
Walks Lan often to school with her friends.
explanation: Trạng từ tần suất đứng sau chủ ngữ và trước động từ thường: S + adv + V + O. → 'Lan often walks to school with her friends.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
sometimes / cooks / dinner / my brother / for the family
options: My brother sometimes dinner cooks for the family.
Cooks my brother sometimes dinner for the family.
My brother cooks sometimes dinner for the family.

explanation: Trạng từ tần suất đứng sau chủ ngữ và trước động từ thường: S + adv + V + O. → 'My brother sometimes cooks dinner for the family.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
I / to bed / before midnight / rarely / go
options: I rarely to bed go before midnight.
I go rarely to bed before midnight.
I rarely go to bed before midnight.
Go I rarely to bed before midnight.
explanation: Trạng từ tần suất đứng sau chủ ngữ và trước động từ thường: S + adv + V + O. → 'I rarely go to bed before midnight.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
is / he / late / always / for class
options: He is always late for class.
He late is always for class.
Late he is always for class.
He is for class always late.
explanation: Trạng từ tần suất đứng sau động từ 'be': S + be + adv + adj. → 'He is always late for class.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
on Monday mornings / we / have / English class
options: We English class have on Monday mornings.
Have we English class on Monday mornings.
We have on Monday mornings English class.
We have English class on Monday mornings.
explanation: Trật tự câu cơ bản: Chủ ngữ + Động từ + Tân ngữ + Thời gian/Cách thức. → 'We have English class on Monday mornings.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
every evening / cooks / my mother / dinner
options: My mother cooks every evening dinner.
My mother dinner cooks every evening.
My mother cooks dinner every evening.

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
the guitar / very well / plays / Nam
options: Nam plays the guitar very well.
Nam plays very well the guitar.
Nam the guitar plays very well.
Plays Nam the guitar very well.
explanation: Trật tự câu cơ bản: Chủ ngữ + Động từ + Tân ngữ + Thời gian/Cách thức. → 'Nam plays the guitar very well.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
the newspaper / every morning / reads / he

He reads the newspaper every morning.

explanation: Trật tự câu cơ bản: Chủ ngữ + Động từ + Tân ngữ + Thời gian/Cách thức. → 'He reads the newspaper every morning.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
do / you / live / where
explanation: Câu hỏi có từ để hỏi: Wh- + trợ động từ/be + chủ ngữ + động từ...? → 'Where do you live?'

question:

What time the last bus does leave for Can Tho?

question:

why / your little brother / is / crying outside

you / do / go swimming / how often

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
who / your English teacher / is
explanation: Câu hỏi có từ để hỏi: Wh- + be + chủ ngữ? → 'Who is your English teacher?'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
how much / this T-shirt / cost / does

How much this T-shirt does cost?
How much does this T-shirt cost?

explanation: Câu hỏi có từ để hỏi: Wh- + trợ động từ/be + chủ ngữ + động từ...? → 'How much does this T-shirt cost?'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
are / you / what / doing now
explanation: Câu hỏi có từ để hỏi: Wh- + trợ động từ/be + chủ ngữ + động từ...? → 'What are you doing now?'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
my sister / in her room / is / still reading / the book I lent her

My sister still reading is the book I lent her in her room.
My sister is still reading the book I lent her in her room.
Still reading my sister is the book I lent her in her room.
explanation: Hiện tại tiếp diễn: S + am/is/are + V-ing + ... → 'My sister is still reading the book I lent her in her room.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
the children / football / are / in the park / playing
options: The children playing are football in the park.
The children are football playing in the park.
Playing the children are football in the park.
The children are playing football in the park.
explanation: Hiện tại tiếp diễn: S + am/is/are + V-ing + ... → 'The children are playing football in the park.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
I / now / waiting / for the bus / am
options: I am waiting for the bus now.
Waiting I am for the bus now.
I waiting am for the bus now.
I am for the bus waiting now.
explanation: Hiện tại tiếp diễn: S + am/is/are + V-ing + ... → 'I am waiting for the bus now.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
we / at the moment / having / are / dinner
options: We are dinner having at the moment.
Having we are dinner at the moment.
We having are dinner at the moment.
We are having dinner at the moment.
explanation: Hiện tại tiếp diễn: S + am/is/are + V-ing + ... → 'We are having dinner at the moment.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
teaching / is / in Room 201 / English / Mr. Long
options: Teaching Mr. Long is English in Room 201.
Mr. Long teaching is English in Room 201.
Mr. Long is teaching English in Room 201.
Mr. Long is English teaching in Room 201.
explanation: Hiện tại tiếp diễn: S + am/is/are + V-ing + ... → 'Mr. Long is teaching English in Room 201.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
are / watching / a movie / they / right now
options: They are a movie watching right now.
They are watching a movie right now.
Watching they are a movie right now.
They watching are a movie right now.
explanation: Hiện tại tiếp diễn: S + am/is/are + V-ing + ... → 'They are watching a movie right now.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
book / this is / interesting / a / very
options: This is a book very interesting.
This is a very interesting book.
This is very a interesting book.
This is a interesting very book.
explanation: Mạo từ đứng đầu cụm danh từ, tính từ đứng trước danh từ: a + adj + noun. → 'This is a very interesting book.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
beautiful / lives in / he / a / old house
options: He lives in beautiful a old house.
He lives in a beautiful old house.
He lives in a old house beautiful.
He a lives in beautiful old house.
explanation: Mạo từ đứng đầu cụm danh từ, tính từ đứng trước danh từ: a + adj + noun. → 'He lives in a beautiful old house.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
had / a / meal / we / delicious
explanation: Mạo từ đứng đầu cụm danh từ, tính từ đứng trước danh từ: a + adj + noun. → 'We had a delicious meal.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
thirty students / my class / in / are / there
options: There are thirty students in my class.
Thirty students there are in my class.
There are thirty students my class in.
There thirty students are in my class.
explanation: Cấu trúc: There + be + danh từ + nơi chốn. → 'There are thirty students in my class.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
a big park / near / my house / there / is
options: There is a big park near my house.
A big park there is near my house.
There is a big park my house near.
There a big park is near my house.
explanation: Cấu trúc: There + be + danh từ + nơi chốn. → 'There is a big park near my house.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
there / the fridge / isn't / in / any milk
options: There isn't any milk in the fridge.
There any milk isn't in the fridge.
There isn't any milk the fridge in.
Any milk there isn't in the fridge.
explanation: Cấu trúc: There + be + danh từ + nơi chốn. → 'There isn't any milk in the fridge.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
there / are / many old buildings / Hoi An / in
options: There are many old buildings Hoi An in.
There are many old buildings in Hoi An.
There many old buildings are in Hoi An.
Many old buildings there are in Hoi An.
explanation: Cấu trúc: There + be + danh từ + nơi chốn. → 'There are many old buildings in Hoi An.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
my grandmother / speak / French / very well / can
options: Speak my grandmother can French very well.
My grandmother can speak French very well.
My grandmother can French speak very well.
My grandmother speak can French very well.
explanation: Động từ khuyết thiếu: S + modal + V nguyên mẫu + O. → 'My grandmother can speak French very well.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
my father / doesn't / at night / coffee / drink
options: My father doesn't drink coffee at night.
My father doesn't coffee drink at night.
My father drink doesn't coffee at night.
Drink my father doesn't coffee at night.
explanation: Câu phủ định: S + trợ động từ + not + V nguyên mẫu + O. → 'My father doesn't drink coffee at night.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
right now / at home / isn't / Lan
options: Lan at home isn't right now.
Lan right now at home isn't.
At home Lan isn't right now.
Lan isn't at home right now.
explanation: Câu phủ định với 'be': S + isn't + nơi chốn + thời gian. → 'Lan isn't at home right now.'

question:
Put the lines in the correct order to make a conversation:
a. A: Nice to meet you, too. Where are you from?
b. A: Hi, I'm Tuan. What's your name?
c. B: I'm from Bac Lieu.
d. B: I'm Lan. Nice to meet you.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: b - d - a - c. Hội thoại luân phiên A – B; mỗi câu trả lời phải đáp đúng câu ngay trước nó (Greetings).

question:
Put the lines in the correct order to make a conversation:
a. A: Can I help you?
b. B: OK, I'll take it.
c. B: Yes, how much is this hat?
d. A: It's 120,000 dong.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: a - c - d - b. Hội thoại luân phiên A – B; mỗi câu trả lời phải đáp đúng câu ngay trước nó (Shopping).

question:
Put the lines in the correct order to make a conversation:
a. B: Yes, I'd like a bowl of pho, please.
b. B: An iced tea, please.
c. A: Are you ready to order?
d. A: Anything to drink?
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: c - a - d - b. Hội thoại luân phiên A – B; mỗi câu trả lời phải đáp đúng câu ngay trước nó (Ordering food).

question:
Put the lines in the correct order to make a conversation:
a. A: Is it far from here?
b. A: Excuse me, where's the nearest ATM?
c. B: It's on Hai Ba Trung Street, next to the bank.
d. B: No, it's about five minutes on foot.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: b - c - a - d. Hội thoại luân phiên A – B; mỗi câu trả lời phải đáp đúng câu ngay trước nó (Directions).

question:
Put the lines in the correct order to make a conversation:
a. B: Tomorrow is fine. What time?
b. A: What about tomorrow night?
c. A: Would you like to go to the cinema tonight?
d. B: Sorry, I can't. I have to study.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: c - d - b - a. Hội thoại luân phiên A – B; mỗi câu trả lời phải đáp đúng câu ngay trước nó (Invitations).

question:
Put the lines in the correct order to make a conversation:
a. A: What's your favorite sport?
b. B: Badminton. I play it every Sunday.
c. B: With my dad and my brother.
d. A: Who do you play with?
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: a - b - d - c. Hội thoại luân phiên A – B; mỗi câu trả lời phải đáp đúng câu ngay trước nó (Hobbies).

question:
Put the lines in the correct order to make a conversation:
a. A: Excuse me, does this bus go to the university?
b. B: At the bus stop across the street.
c. B: No, it doesn't. You need bus number 9.
d. A: Where can I catch it?
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: a - c - d - b. Hội thoại luân phiên A – B; mỗi câu trả lời phải đáp đúng câu ngay trước nó (Transportation).

question:
Put the lines in the correct order to make a conversation:
a. A: It's too big. Do you have a smaller one?
b. B: Sure. The fitting room is over there.
c. A: Can I try on this jacket?
d. B: Yes, here's a medium.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: c - b - a - d. Hội thoại luân phiên A – B; mỗi câu trả lời phải đáp đúng câu ngay trước nó (Shopping).

question:
Put the lines in the correct order to make a conversation:
a. B: Oh, how lovely! Thank you so much.
b. A: This is a small gift for you.
c. B: Thank you! Come in, please.
d. A: Hi Mai! Happy birthday!
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: d - c - b - a. Hội thoại luân phiên A – B; mỗi câu trả lời phải đáp đúng câu ngay trước nó (Social).

question:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a paragraph:
a. Every morning, I get up at 6 a.m. and have breakfast.
b. After that, I ride my bike to the university.
c. My name is Khoa, and I live in Can Tho.
d. In the evening, I do my homework and go to bed at 11.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: c - a - b - d. Câu giới thiệu → buổi sáng → sau đó → buổi tối.

question:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a paragraph:
a. It is famous for its floating markets.
b. The most famous one is Cai Rang Floating Market.
c. Can Tho is a big city in the Mekong Delta.
d. Every morning, many boats sell fruit and vegetables there.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: c - a - b - d. Giới thiệu Cần Thơ → nổi tiếng với chợ nổi → chợ nổi nổi tiếng nhất ('The most famous one') → hoạt động ở đó ('there').

question:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a paragraph:
a. I love taking photos.
b. I usually take them with my phone in the park near my house.
c. In the future, I hope to buy a real camera.
d. I want to tell you about my hobby.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: d - a - b - c. Giới thiệu chủ đề → nêu sở thích (taking photos) → 'them' thay cho 'photos' nên phải đứng sau → dự định tương lai ('In the future').

question:
Choose the best way to combine the sentences:
It was raining. We stayed at home.
options: Although it was raining, we stayed at home.
It was raining, so we stayed at home.
It was raining because we stayed at home.
Because it was raining, so we stayed at home.
explanation: Vế sau là kết quả → 'so'. Không dùng 'because' và 'so' cùng lúc trong một câu.

question:
Choose the best way to combine the sentences:
Nam is tired. He worked late last night.
options: Because Nam is tired, he worked late last night.
Nam is tired because he worked late last night.
Nam is tired but he worked late last night.
Nam is tired so he worked late last night.
explanation: Làm việc khuya là NGUYÊN NHÂN khiến Nam mệt → 'because' đặt trước nguyên nhân.

question:
Choose the sentence with the same meaning:
There are 30 students in my class.
options: There is 30 students in my class.
explanation: 'There are 30 students in my class' ⇔ 'My class has 30 students' (danh từ số nhiều 'students').

question:
Choose the correct question for this answer:
I live in Ninh Kieu District.
explanation: Hỏi nơi ở → 'Where' + trợ động từ 'do' + chủ ngữ + V: 'Where do you live?'

question:
Choose the correct question for this answer:
She goes to work by bus.
options: By what does she go to work?
How she usually goes to work?
How does she go to work?
How is she going to work every day?
explanation: Hỏi phương tiện → 'How'. Chủ ngữ 'she' → 'does' + V nguyên mẫu: 'How does she go...?'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
until every application has been reviewed / the final decision / will not be announced / by the committee
options: By the committee will not be announced the final decision until every application has been reviewed.
The final decision will not be announced until every application has been reviewed by the committee.
Will not be announced the final decision by the committee until every application has been reviewed.
The final decision will not be announced by the committee until every application has been reviewed.
explanation: Câu bị động: chủ ngữ nhận hành động + will not be + V3; cụm thời gian 'until...' đứng cuối. → 'The final decision will not be announced by the committee until every application has been reviewed.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
the girl / whose presentation won first prize / from Soc Trang / comes
options: The girl comes whose presentation won first prize from Soc Trang.
Comes the girl whose presentation won first prize from Soc Trang.
Whose presentation won first prize the girl comes from Soc Trang.
The girl whose presentation won first prize comes from Soc Trang.
explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ sở hữu đứng ngay sau danh từ nó bổ nghĩa ('the girl whose presentation...'), sau đó mới đến động từ chính 'comes'. → 'The girl whose presentation won first prize comes from Soc Trang.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
is / could you tell me / where / the post office
options: Where is the post office could you tell me?
Could you tell me where the post office is?
Could you tell me the post office where is?
Could you tell me where is the post office?
explanation: Câu hỏi gián tiếp: Could you tell me + từ để hỏi + chủ ngữ + động từ (không đảo 'is' lên trước chủ ngữ). → 'Could you tell me where the post office is?'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
more free time / if I / I would / learn Japanese / had
options: I would learn Japanese if I more free time had.
I would learn Japanese if I had more free time.
I would had if I learn Japanese more free time.
If I had I would learn Japanese more free time.
explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 2: S + would + V + if + S + quá khứ đơn + ... → 'I would learn Japanese if I had more free time.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
never / in front of such a large audience / have / I / been asked to speak
options: Never I have been asked to speak in front of such a large audience.
I been asked to speak have never in front of such a large audience.
I have never been asked to speak in front of such a large audience.
I have been asked to speak never in front of such a large audience.
explanation: Hiện tại hoàn thành bị động với 'never': S + have + never + been + V3. → 'I have never been asked to speak in front of such a large audience.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
used to / when he was young / on a farm / my grandfather / work
options: Used to my grandfather work on a farm when he was young.
My grandfather used to on a farm work when he was young.
My grandfather work used to on a farm when he was young.
My grandfather used to work on a farm when he was young.
explanation: 'used to + V nguyên mẫu' đứng ngay sau chủ ngữ: S + used to + V + nơi chốn + thời gian. → 'My grandfather used to work on a farm when he was young.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
would be free the following day / I / whether / asked me / she
options: She asked me whether would be free the following day I.
She whether I would be free the following day asked me.
She asked me whether I would be free the following day.
She asked me would be free the following day whether I.
explanation: Tường thuật câu hỏi Yes/No: S + asked + O + whether + S + V; 'tomorrow' lùi thành 'the following day'. → 'She asked me whether I would be free the following day.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
too hot / is / for me / to drink / this coffee
options: This coffee is too hot for me to drink.
This coffee too hot is for me to drink.
This coffee is to drink too hot for me.
This coffee is for me too hot to drink.
explanation: Cấu trúc: S + be + too + tính từ + for + O + to V (quá... để ai làm gì). → 'This coffee is too hot for me to drink.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
the test / was / that / so difficult / nobody finished it
options: The test was so difficult that nobody finished it.
The test so difficult was that nobody finished it.
The test was that so difficult nobody finished it.
The test was so difficult nobody finished it that.
explanation: Cấu trúc: S + be + so + tính từ + that + mệnh đề (quá... đến nỗi). → 'The test was so difficult that nobody finished it.'

question:
Put the words in the correct order:
next week / you / I / to meeting / am looking forward
options: I am looking forward you to meeting next week.
I am looking forward to meeting next week you.
I to meeting am looking forward you next week.
I am looking forward to meeting you next week.
explanation: 'look forward to + V-ing': I am looking forward to meeting you + thời gian. → 'I am looking forward to meeting you next week.'

question:
Put the lines in the correct order to make a conversation:
a. B: Sure. I graduated in accounting last year, and I've been working part-time at a bank since then.
b. B: Thank you for inviting me.
c. A: So, can you tell me a little about yourself?
d. A: Thank you for coming in today. Please take a seat.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: d - b - c - a. Hội thoại luân phiên A – B; mỗi câu trả lời phải đáp đúng câu ngay trước nó (Job interview).

question:
Put the lines in the correct order to make a conversation:
a. B: Hi, this is Room 208. The air conditioner isn't working.
b. A: About fifteen minutes.
c. A: I'm sorry about that. I'll send someone to look at it right away.
d. B: Thank you. How long will it take?
e. A: Reception. How can I help you?
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: e - a - c - d - b. Hội thoại luân phiên A – B; mỗi câu trả lời phải đáp đúng câu ngay trước nó (Hotel problem).

question:
Put the lines in the correct order to make a conversation:
a. A: If I were you, I'd go to Da Lat. It's cooler in summer.
b. B: That's a good point. I'll look for cheap hotels there.
c. A: Have you decided what to do for the summer holiday?
d. B: Not yet. I'm thinking of either Da Lat or Nha Trang.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: c - d - a - b. Hội thoại luân phiên A – B; mỗi câu trả lời phải đáp đúng câu ngay trước nó (Holiday plans).

question:
Put the lines in the correct order to make a conversation:
a. B: Just some paracetamol last night.
b. A: Good morning. What seems to be the problem?
c. A: I see. Have you taken any medicine?
d. B: I've had a high temperature since yesterday.
e. A: OK. I'll give you a prescription. Drink plenty of water and get some rest.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: b - d - c - a - e. Hội thoại luân phiên A – B; mỗi câu trả lời phải đáp đúng câu ngay trước nó (At the doctor).

question:
Put the lines in the correct order to make a conversation:
a. A: Hi. I bought this shirt here last week, but it's too small.
b. A: I'd like to exchange it for a larger size, please.
c. B: Thanks. Would you like to exchange it or get a refund?
d. B: Do you have the receipt?
e. A: Yes, here it is.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: a - d - e - c - b. Hội thoại luân phiên A – B; mỗi câu trả lời phải đáp đúng câu ngay trước nó (Returning an item).

question:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a paragraph:
a. Firstly, working helps students earn money to pay for their living costs.
b. Many people believe that university students should have a part-time job.
c. However, students should not work too many hours, or their studies may suffer.
d. Secondly, they can gain experience that will be useful when they look for a full-time job.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: b - a - d - c. Câu chủ đề → 'Firstly' → 'Secondly' → 'However' (ý trái chiều, đặt cuối).

question:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a paragraph:
a. Luckily, a local farmer stopped and helped us repair it.
b. To thank him, we bought him lunch at a small restaurant in the next village.
c. On the first day, our motorbike broke down in the middle of the mountains.
d. Last month, I went on a trip to Ha Giang with three friends.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: d - c - a - b. Mở đầu chuyến đi → sự cố ngày đầu tiên → 'Luckily' (được giúp đỡ) → 'To thank him' (cảm ơn người đã giúp).

question:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a paragraph:
a. First, you need an acceptance letter from the university.
b. After that, fill in the online application form and pay the fee.
c. Finally, you will be invited to an interview at the embassy.
d. Applying for a student visa can take a long time, so you should start early.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: d - a - b - c. Câu chủ đề (nên bắt đầu sớm) → 'First' → 'After that' → 'Finally'.

question:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a paragraph:
a. I would like a full refund as soon as possible.
b. I am writing to complain about the laptop I ordered from your website on 2 May.
c. When it arrived, the screen was broken.
d. Dear Sir or Madam,
e. Yours faithfully, Nguyen Lan
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: d - b - c - a - e. Email trang trọng: 'Dear Sir or Madam' → lý do viết → chi tiết vấn đề ('When it arrived') → yêu cầu → 'Yours faithfully' và tên.

question:
Put the sentences in the correct order to make a paragraph:
a. In my opinion, the advantages are greater than the disadvantages.
b. Living in a big city has both advantages and disadvantages.
c. On the other hand, the cost of living is high and the air is often polluted.
d. On the one hand, there are more job opportunities and better hospitals.
explanation: Thứ tự đúng: b - d - c - a. Câu chủ đề (có cả ưu và nhược điểm) → 'On the one hand' → 'On the other hand' → kết luận 'In my opinion'.

question:
Choose the best way to combine the sentences:
I met a man. He can speak five languages.
options: I met a man whom can speak five languages.
The man who I met him can speak five languages.
I met a man who can speak five languages.
I met a man who he can speak five languages.
explanation: Thay 'He' (chỉ người) bằng đại từ quan hệ 'who'; không giữ lại 'he' trong mệnh đề quan hệ.

question:
Choose the best way to combine the sentences:
He was very tired. He kept working until midnight.
options: He was very tired, so he kept working until midnight.
Although he was very tired, he kept working until midnight.
Despite he was very tired, he kept working until midnight.
Because he was very tired, he kept working until midnight.
explanation: Hai ý trái ngược (mệt nhưng vẫn làm) → 'Although' + mệnh đề. 'Despite' không đi với mệnh đề.

question:
Choose the best way to combine the sentences:
You can borrow my bike. You must return it before 6 p.m.
options: You can borrow my bike although you return it before 6 p.m.
You can borrow my bike so that you return it before 6 p.m.
You can borrow my bike as long as you return it before 6 p.m.
You can borrow my bike unless you return it before 6 p.m.
explanation: Điều kiện để được mượn xe → 'as long as' (miễn là). 'unless' = trừ khi (sai nghĩa).

question:
Choose the sentence with the same meaning:
People grow coffee in the Central Highlands.
options: Coffee was grown by the Central Highlands.
Coffee grows people in the Central Highlands.
Coffee is grown in the Central Highlands.
People are grown coffee in the Central Highlands.
explanation: Chuyển sang bị động hiện tại đơn: tân ngữ 'coffee' làm chủ ngữ + is + V3 ('is grown'). Có thể bỏ 'by people'.

question:
Choose the sentence with the same meaning:
I haven't seen Lan for two months.
options: I have seen Lan for two months.
I didn't see Lan two months ago.
The last time I saw Lan was two months ago.
I saw Lan for two months.
explanation: 'haven't seen... for two months' (đã 2 tháng không gặp) ⇔ 'The last time I saw Lan was two months ago' (lần cuối gặp là 2 tháng trước).

question:
Choose the sentence with the same meaning:
"I'm going to visit my grandparents," said Hoa.
options: Hoa said me that she would visit my grandparents.
Hoa told that she was going to visit her grandparents.
Hoa said that I had been going to visit her grandparents.
Hoa said that she was going to visit her grandparents.
explanation: Tường thuật: đổi ngôi 'I' → 'she', 'my' → 'her'; lùi thì 'am going to' → 'was going to'. 'told' phải có tân ngữ (told me), nên 'Hoa told that...' sai.

question:
Choose the sentence with the same meaning:
I don't have a car, so I can't drive you to the airport.
options: If I had a car, I couldn't drive you to the airport.
If I have a car, I can't drive you to the airport.
If I had a car, I could drive you to the airport.
If I didn't have a car, I could drive you to the airport.
explanation: Giả định trái với hiện tại → câu điều kiện loại 2, đảo nghĩa khẳng định/phủ định: không có xe → 'If I had a car, I could drive you...'.

question:
Choose the sentence with the same meaning:
This is the first time I have eaten durian.
options: I have eaten durian many times.
This is the last time I eat durian.
I have never eaten durian before.
I ate durian for the first time last year.
explanation: 'This is the first time I have eaten...' (lần đầu tiên ăn) ⇔ 'I have never eaten... before' (trước đây chưa từng ăn).

question:
Choose the sentence with the same meaning:
The bag was so heavy that I couldn't lift it.
options: The bag was so heavy for me not to lift it.
The bag was not heavy enough for me to lift.
The bag was too heavy for me to lift.
The bag was too heavy that I could not lift.
explanation: 'so... that... couldn't' ⇔ 'too + adj + for sb + to V'. Không lặp lại tân ngữ 'it' sau 'to lift' vì chủ ngữ 'The bag' chính là vật được nhấc.

question:
Choose the sentence with the same meaning:
Although it rained heavily, we went to the beach.
options: Despite it rained heavily, we went to the beach.
Although the heavy rain, we went to the beach.
Because of the heavy rain, we went to the beach.
Despite the heavy rain, we went to the beach.
explanation: 'Although + mệnh đề' ⇔ 'Despite + cụm danh từ' ('the heavy rain'). 'Despite' không đi với mệnh đề; 'Although' không đi với cụm danh từ.
